covers_spec: SPEC.md §HostAdapter contract (D13); §Phase 7 review — Command-capability matrix; Stage-1 runtime export delegation; export-only drivers (windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot)

entry_points.summary: nested dict {host_name: {command_id: CommandTier}}; populated at adapter import time
canonical tuple of 15 /z-* command families; adapters must declare a tier for every entry or raise
registers per-host command tiers; raises ValueError if any KNOWN_COMMANDS entry is missing
O(1) lookup (host, command) -> CommandTier; returns 'blocked' for unknowns (fail-safe)
frozen dataclass of static per-host capability flags
re-export from runtime.drivers._export_utils; canonical import location for z_harness_cli callers
probes all four adapters; returns (adapter, DetectResult) pairs in canonical order
resolves host with optional Rich picker; raises UnknownHostError / NoHostInstalledError
native-fidelity adapter; export_payload is persona-only from personas/builtin/ (plugin handles commands/skills)
high-fidelity adapter; export_payload runs two-stage pipeline (runtime + persona loop from personas/builtin/)
flattened adapter; export_payload runs two-stage pipeline producing .mdc rule files
flattened adapter; export_payload runs two-stage pipeline producing prompts/ flat files; MCP global/persistent (F4)
export-only: writes .windsurf/rules/<id>.md with trigger frontmatter; Agent/Skill lines replaced with hint comments
export-only: default pointer strategy — single .clinerules/z-harness.md; curated/full available via config
export-only: always single .github/copilot-instructions.md consolidated catalog regardless of strategy

native.description: Full orchestration + native personas. All /z-* commands run identically to the Claude Code reference. Multi-agent dispatch (subagents, panels, consults, gates) works natively.

high.description: Native skills/personas, single-agent only. Multi-agent commands (/z-implement-all, /z-panel, /z-consult, /z-gate) are degraded (single-agent transliteration, not blocked). All other /z-* commands run at native fidelity.

flattened.description: Transliterated rules, single-agent only. z-harness rules injected via host-native config file. Single-agent /z-* commands run in degraded mode. Multi-agent commands are blocked.

curated.description: Export-only concept tier. Curated rule/steering files with host-specific frontmatter (trigger for Windsurf, inclusion for Kiro). No adapter, no launch/inject. ExportResult.fidelity reports 'flattened' (Agent/Skill calls replaced with hint comments).

pointer.description: Export-only concept tier. Single pointer/instructions file. No adapter, no launch/inject. ExportResult.fidelity reports 'pointer'.

antigravity.collision_domain: workflows/ + rules/ (z-harness- prefix stripped) + skills/ stems

windsurf.structural_rule: YAML frontmatter with 'trigger' key: always_on (for _ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS), glob (when source has 'globs' field), model_decision (default)

kiro.structural_rule: YAML frontmatter with 'inclusion' key: always (_ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS), manual (others); fileMatch with fileMatchPattern when applicable

cline.structural_rule: plain markdown, non-empty body; no frontmatter required
cline.note: default pointer avoids bloating Cline (loads all .clinerules/ on every prompt)

copilot.structural_rule: always single file regardless of configured strategy; consolidates command/agent/skill catalog from frontmatter descriptions only (no source body rewriting)
copilot.note: strategy config is read but collapsed by single-file constraint

codex.mcp_note: Global/persistent write to ~/.codex/config.toml via runtime.drivers.codex.mcp.ensure_mcp_registered(); not reversed by ephemeral cleanup (F4)

windsurf.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.windsurf.export only.

kiro.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.kiro.export only.

cline.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.cline.export only.
cline.structural_rule: plain markdown, non-empty body, no frontmatter required

copilot.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.copilot.export only.
copilot.structural_rule: always single file; catalog of descriptions only (no body rewriting performed)

command_tiers.note: Multi-agent commands are 'degraded' on high-fidelity hosts and 'blocked' on flattened hosts. All other /z-* commands are 'native' on claude, 'native' on antigravity, and 'degraded' on cursor/codex. Export-only hosts (windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot) have no command-tier registration — they are not in the adapter registry.

per_tier.curated: export-only — no command tiers; not in adapter registry
per_tier.pointer: export-only — no command tiers; not in adapter registry

invariants: fidelity_tier is a static property on each adapter class; never computed at runtime
multi-agent commands (z-implement-all, z-panel, z-consult, z-gate) are degraded on high-tier hosts and blocked on flattened hosts
flattened = single-agent transliteration only; no subagent dispatch
high = native skill/persona loading via host-native mechanism; single-agent only; subagent dispatch absent
native = full orchestration including multi-agent subagent dispatch
cleanup_strategy=ephemeral for all four adapters in v1; MCP writes are global/persistent and NOT reversed by cleanup (F4)
ExportResult must be imported from z_harness_cli.adapters.base, not from runtime.drivers._export_utils directly (one-way layering)
ClaudeAdapter.export_payload is persona-only; Stage 1 runtime export is not run (native plugin handles commands/skills)
all persona exports source from personas/builtin/ not personas/ root (which holds only README.md)
non-empty Stage-1 warnings raise RuntimeError immediately (legacy hard-gate; no silent downgrade)
persona-name collision with Stage-1 exported ids raises RuntimeError (MINOR-6)

windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot are export-only: no adapter module at z_harness_cli/adapters/<host>.py, no registry entry, no command tiers (M5 invariant — validated by TestAdapterAbsence in test_export_golden.py)
windsurf and kiro ExportResult.fidelity is 'flattened' (not 'curated') because Agent/Skill lines are replaced with hint comments
copilot export is always single-file regardless of configured strategy; strategy config is read but collapsed
gotchas: cursor and codex both declare fidelity=flattened but differ in MCP surface: cursor has supports_user_mcp=True, codex does not
antigravity uses ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_ROOT; all three other adapters inject CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
codex MCP registration is global (~/.codex/config.toml) and survives session cleanup; explicit removal only via z-harness doctor --clear-mcp
cursor needs_trust_prompt=True means inject() must not assume non-interactive; surface the prompt via PTY
canonical adapter order in registry: claude (native) > antigravity (high) > cursor (flattened) > codex (flattened)
register_command_tiers() raises ValueError at import time if KNOWN_COMMANDS entry is missing — misconfigured adapters fail fast
antigravity collision domain is workflows/rules/skills stems (z-harness- prefix stripped from rules); cursor uses .cursor/rules/ stems; codex uses prompts/ stems only (AGENTS.md excluded)
windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot are NOT adapters: registry.select(<host>) raises UnknownHostError for them; z_harness_cli/adapters/ has no module for them
windsurf and kiro ExportResult.fidelity is 'flattened' not 'curated' — the curated/pointer tier concepts are architectural labels; ExportResult.fidelity reflects the rewrite strategy applied
cline default strategy is pointer (single file) because Cline loads all .clinerules/ files on every prompt; curated/full forces more files and should be set explicitly in config.toml
copilot body rewriting never occurs — output is catalog of frontmatter descriptions only, so no Agent/Skill call sites exist in the output
